{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/merge_duplicates.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"One-time script for LIFE-203: merge duplicate household records.

Finds groups of active households that are really the same family (via
registry.dedup.find_duplicates), keeps the record whose household ID is valid,
and marks every other record in the group as "merged" into the kept record.
No record is deleted and no other fields are touched.

Run once:  python scripts/merge_duplicates.py
"""

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates
from registry.register import load_households, set_status


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households(active_only=False)
    groups = find_duplicates(households)
    print(f"found {len(groups)} duplicate group(s)")

    kept_by_group: dict[tuple[str, ...], str] = {}
    for group in groups:
        valid = [hid for hid in group if is_valid_household_id(hid)]
        if not valid:
            print(f"group {group}: no valid household ID, leaving untouched")
            continue
        kept_id = valid[0]
        kept_by_group[tuple(group)] = kept_id
        for other_id in group:
            if other_id != kept_id:
                set_status(other_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)
        print(f"group {group}: kept {kept_id}, merged the rest into it")

    # Verify: no records were deleted, each merged group has exactly one active
    # record, and the kept record has a valid household ID.
    after = load_households(active_only=False)
    active_after = load_households(active_only=True)
    assert len(after) == len(households), "records were deleted"
    for group, kept_id in kept_by_group.items():
        active_ids = [h.id for h in active_after if h.id in group]
        assert active_ids == [kept_id], f"group {group}: active records {active_ids}"
        assert is_valid_household_id(kept_id), f"kept ID {kept_id} is not valid"
    print("verification passed: one active record per merged group, valid kept IDs, nothing deleted")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}}
